name: Terraforming Control
desc: The coordination center for terraforming on this world. Climate models, survey crews and work schedules run from here, by procedures the Eridani-Utopia Terraforming Corporation wrote before the Collapse.

name: Atmospheric Scrubber
desc: A planet-wide lattice of catalytic towers, built to an Eridani-Utopia pattern. They break down the toxic compounds in the air, one cubic kilometer at a time.

name: Atmospheric Vent
desc: Pressure stacks bleed the excess atmosphere into space, until the air at the surface can be breathed without a pressure suit.

name: Atmospheric Accretor
desc: Volatile crackers and gas mass drivers thicken a thin atmosphere. Eridani-Utopia used the same method on worlds that were almost good enough.

name: Atmospheric Forge
desc: A full atmosphere program: comet capture, volatile cracking and gas injection on a planetary scale. It gives an airless world an atmosphere from nothing.

name: Stellar Shade
desc: An ultra-light foil in a stable orbit between the planet and its star. It turns a share of the light away, as the Eridani-Utopia engineers did on a hundred worlds.

name: Stellar Shade Array
desc: An array of great shades, flown in formation. Together they can cool a world that melts lead.

name: Stellar Mirror
desc: An orbital mirror that gathers starlight which would miss the planet and sends it to the surface.

name: Stellar Mirror Array
desc: An array of great mirrors, flown in formation. Together they can thaw a world of frozen gas.

name: Crustal Stabilizer
desc: Deep boreholes release stress from the faults under the colony. Many small quakes on a schedule take the place of the big ones.

name: Crustal Anchor Array
desc: A grid of anchors driven down to the mantle, with heat sinks that drain the energy that moves the plates. It calms a world that never stops shaking.

name: Storm Dampener Grid
desc: Weather stations and orbital heaters spread the heat that feeds the worst storms. Year by year the climate settles into calmer patterns.

name: Reclamation Plant
desc: Filter beds, soil washers and engineered microbes pull industrial waste out of the air, the water and the ground. It cannot keep up with a building that still pollutes.

name: Biome Regulator
desc: Seeded microbes and targeted toxins push back the native life that attacks crops and colonists, and make room for an ecology people can live with.

name: Magnetosphere Generator
desc: Superconducting rings around the planet raise a magnetic field that turns the radiation aside before it reaches the surface.

name: Solar Concentrator
desc: A swarm of orbital lenses gathers weak starlight and focuses it on the surface. It needs a true star: a nebula or a black hole gives it nothing to work with.

name: Captive Sun
desc: A small fusion sun, lit in a stable orbit around the planet. Once it burns, it feeds itself, and a dark or dim world gets a day of its own. It needs no star.

name: Comet Shepherd
desc: Tugs go out to the edge of the system, catch ice comets and steer them onto a slow fall toward the planet. The ice breaks up high in the air and comes down as rain. One build makes the world one step wetter.

name: Hydrosphere Extractor
desc: Deep wells and orbital lifters draw water out of the seas and the ground and send it off the planet as ice. Lakes shrink to plains, and the old seabed makes good soil. One build makes the world one step drier.

name: Soil Conditioner
desc: Field crews break up the hardpan, work organic matter into the ground and seed it with microbes that turn dead dust into living soil. One build improves the farmland step by step, up to rich farmland.

name: Gaian Soil Engine
desc: Deep fungal networks, engineered soil fauna and nitrogen-fixing cultures grow together into one living system that keeps the ground in balance by itself. It turns rich farmland into bountiful farmland.

name: Climate Harmonizer
desc: Weather satellites, heat exchangers and a web of ground stations tune the climate of the whole planet. The seasons soften, and the rains come when the fields need them. It works only on a habitable world free of extreme weather, pollution, hostile native life and tectonic activity.

name: Reef Seeder
desc: Seeding boats lay artificial reefs, kelp lines and young fish across the shallows, and the sea slowly fills with life. One build takes the marine life up step by step, to thriving.

name: Ocean Seeding Fleet
desc: A fleet of seeding ships works the open sea. It releases engineered plankton, deep-water species and whole reef colonies grown in orbit, until every part of the ocean holds its own web of life. It turns a thriving sea into an abundant one.

name: Lobster Hatchery
desc: Deep pressure tanks hold a copy of Volturn's lobster beds, grown from breeding stock smuggled out of Askonia. The Sindrian Diktat guards its lobster closely, and it treats such a hatchery as theft.

name: Atmospheric Siphon
desc: Orbital intakes skim the air from the top of the sky and send it off into space. Year by year the sky thins and goes black, and the storms die with it. Some industries work best in a vacuum.

name: Deep Core Extractor
desc: Plasma bores reach the transplutonic veins deep below the crust and strip them far faster than any mine. Step by step the seams run thin, until nothing worth taking is left.

name: Volatiles Extractor
desc: Deep wells tap the reservoirs of ice, gas and hydrocarbons under the surface and pump them out far faster than any mine could. Step by step the reservoirs run dry, until the last of them is drawn off.

name: Civic Integration
desc: Clinics, schools and registry offices go out to the scattered settlements beyond the colony's law. Year by year their people take up papers, trade and work, until nobody remembers where the old line ran.

name: Labor Camps
desc: Fenced work settlements, where the survivors outside the colony's law are rounded up and put to hard labor. The work is cheap and the camps keep filling, but the colony is not proud of them, and the Luddic Path takes note.

name: Purge Detachment
desc: Armed detachments sweep the ruins and the wilds and end the decivilized holdouts for good. It is quick, and it works. It is also an atrocity, and the rest of the Sector will hear of it.

name: Domed Cities
desc: Sealed domes cover the colony's cities, each with its own air, water and climate. Outside, the planet stays as hostile as ever. Inside, people live and work without pressure suits.

name: City Agrav Grid
desc: Gravity plates under the streets and floors of the domed cities pull or push everything toward a standard gravity. Outside the domes, the planet's own gravity still rules. It works only together with the domes.

name: Impact Defense Grid
desc: Orbital guns and lasers track every rock that falls toward the colony and break it up high in the sky. What reaches the ground is gravel and dust.

name: Hydroponic Farms
desc: Racks of crops grow under lamps in sealed halls, fed by recycled water and nutrient mist instead of soil. They feed a colony that has no fields, though never as well as real farmland.
